title: PILOT
name: PILOT
short_description: Generates 3D ligand candidates conditioned on a protein and reference ligand.
description: PILOT is an equivariant diffusion model for pocket-conditioned de novo ligand generation. This service runs its upstream dataset-free sampling path with the included CrossDocked checkpoint, a single protein PDB, and a reference-ligand SDF in the same coordinate frame.
dataset_info: The included last.pt checkpoint is trained on CrossDocked. Dataset-free inference recovers model priors from the checkpoint and uses the reference ligand atom count; training data is not required.
observations: Provide one protein PDB and one reference-ligand SDF whose coordinates share the same frame. PILOT selects pocket residues within the configured cutoff of the reference ligand. Generated molecules are candidates and are not experimentally validated; no affinity or docking score is produced.
input_data: Exactly one protein PDB and one reference-ligand SDF, plus an optional JSON sampling configuration.
output_data: A ZIP archive containing generated ligand structures and a JSON summary; the summary is also returned separately.
features: Samples candidate ligand structures using the included PILOT CrossDocked checkpoint. Sample count, batch size, sampling iterations, pocket cutoff, and Lipinski filtering are configurable.
strengths: Generates 3D ligand candidates conditioned on protein pocket structure using an equivariant diffusion model and checkpoint-derived priors.
weaknesses: Requires a reference ligand with coordinates in the same frame as the protein. Generated candidates are not affinity predictions or experimentally validated compounds; GPU resources are recommended.

assistant.description: This is an LLM based PILOT expert.

nodes.name: Protein PDB, reference-ligand SDF, and optional sampling config
